stories.title: Direct attacks on ships in Hormuz
stories.what: Attacks on commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz have continued into November, including a VLCC whose engine room was struck in Omani waters, reported as the fifth confirmed attack in the first three days of the month.
stories.why_it_matters: Strikes on hulls raise war-risk premiums and crew-safety objections for Arabian Gulf liftings, shrinking the pool of willing owners and supporting crude and product tanker earnings.
sources: How will the 'blue tsunami' impact Trump administration policies?

stories.title: Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab transits and Gulf congestion
stories.what: Strait of Hormuz traffic rose in October to its highest monthly level since July, supported by stronger dry bulk and LNG movements even as VLCC traffic declined. Red Sea traffic also rose. Vessel waiting remains elevated across the Arabian Gulf.
stories.why_it_matters: Transit counts and waiting times show whether ships route through or around high-risk waters, changing voyage lengths, tonne-mile demand and effective fleet supply.
sources: LR Advisory launches Supply Chain Resilience service

stories.title: US sanctions on Iran shadow-fleet registries
stories.what: The United States sanctioned a network of individuals and companies accused of running fraudulent ship registries and false-flag services for Iranian shadow fleet vessels, alongside a new warning to the industry.
stories.why_it_matters: Flag and registry fraud sanctions force charterers, insurers and class societies to re-check documentation, and can push sanctioned tonnage out of mainstream trades, tightening compliant tanker supply.
stories.latest: Sanctions announced Wednesday targeting fraudulent registries serving Iran's shadow fleet.
sources: Latest US sanctions target dark fleet false-flag network
U.S. Targets Fraudulent Ship Registries Used by Iran's Shadow Fleet

stories.title: Drone attacks on shipping in the western Black Sea
stories.what: A Greek container ship sank after being hit by naval drones off Bulgaria, the latest in a series of strikes in the western Black Sea.
stories.why_it_matters: Attacks on ships and port infrastructure threaten grain and dry bulk loadings from the region and add insurance and routing costs for any vessel calling there.
sources: Webinar: Navigating the danger zone: How to protect your fleet from GPS attacks

stories.title: Russian diesel flows and export restrictions
stories.what: A reported US-Russia agreement on supplying extra diesel to the US market has met political opposition, while Russia has extended a general ban on most diesel exports until the end of January, with some volumes still allowed to flow.
stories.why_it_matters: Diesel export restrictions and any reopened Atlantic route reshape clean product tanker ton-miles and MR and LR employment patterns.
sources: How will the 'blue tsunami' impact Trump administration policies?

stories.title: Port labour disruption in the US and Europe
stories.what: A contract standoff involving 250 security workers threatens to freeze operations across Los Angeles and Long Beach terminals after a 4 November deadline extension, while dockworkers struck across Europe and beyond over arms shipments through their ports.
stories.why_it_matters: Labour action at container and ferry berths disrupts berthing schedules and cargo flows, and the unresolved US West Coast dispute leaves a large share of US import capacity exposed to stoppage.
sources: Transpacific emerges as liner shipping's golden trade
